{"model_py":"from pathlib import Path

import math
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import mujoco


def build(output_dir):
    out = Path(output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out / 'textures').mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    def text_image(filename, title, subtitle, background, foreground, size=(768, 192)):
        im = Image.new('RGB', size, background)
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        f = ImageFont.load_default(size=64)
        s = ImageFont.load_default(size=26)
        d.text((24, 18), title, font=f, fill=foreground)
        d.text((26, 112), subtitle, font=s, fill=foreground)
        im.save(out / 'textures' / filename)

    text_image('s220.png', 'S220    Covaris', 'FOCUSED ULTRASONICATOR', '#d3d6d6', '#087f9e')
    text_image('ch03.png', '7.0 C', 'CH03   CIRCULATING COOLER', '#18352c', '#68e9a2')
    text_image('warning.png', '!  DEIONIZED WATER ONLY', 'S220  /  WATER LEVEL REFERENCE 12', '#eedc37', '#272826')
    text_image('holder.png', 'Covaris', '500114', '#33383b', '#d5d7d4')

    def string(v):
        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)):
            return ' '.join(string(x) for x in v)
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
            return format(float(v), '.12g')
        return str(v)

    def el(parent, tag, **attrs):
        return ET.SubElement(parent, tag, {k: string(v) for k, v in attrs.items() if v is not None})

    def mul(a, b):
        w, x, y, z = a
        W, X, Y, Z = b
        return np.array([w*W-x*X-y*Y-z*Z, w*X+x*W+y*Z-z*Y,
                         w*Y-x*Z+y*W+z*X, w*Z+x*Y-y*X+z*W])

    def axis_quat(axis, angle):
        a = np.asarray(axis, float)
        a /= np.linalg.norm(a)
        return np.r_[math.cos(angle/2), a*math.sin(angle/2)]

    def z_to(direction):
        d = np.asarray(direction, float)
        d /= np.linalg.norm(d)
        if d[2] < -0.999999:
            return np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])
        q = np.r_[1+d[2], -d[1], d[0], 0.]
        return q / np.linalg.norm(q)

    el(root, 'compiler', angle='radian', autolimits='true', inertiafromgeom='auto')
    el(root, 'option', timestep=0.001, gravity=[0, 0, -9.81], integrator='implicitfast', iterations=80)
    default = el(root, 'default')
    el(default, 'geom', friction=[0.65, 0.005, 0.0001], condim=3,
       margin=0.000005, solref=[0.008, 1], solimp=[0.95, 0.99, 0.001])
    el(default, 'joint', damping=0.02, armature=0.000001)
    asset = el(root, 'asset')
    materials = {
        'silver': ([0.66, 0.69, 0.70, 1], 0.42),
        'light_silver': ([0.80, 0.81, 0.79, 1], 0.32),
        'dark': ([0.075, 0.085, 0.095, 1], 0.25),
        'black': ([0.025, 0.030, 0.033, 1], 0.24),
        'steel': ([0.56, 0.60, 0.62, 1], 0.72),
        'brass': ([0.80, 0.67, 0.42, 1], 0.45),
        'tank_glass': ([0.76, 0.88, 0.91, 0.23], 0.65),
        'tube_glass': ([0.78, 0.90, 0.96, 0.30], 0.70),
        'cap_clear': ([0.81, 0.86, 0.88, 0.58], 0.45),
        'membrane': ([0.82, 0.85, 0.84, 0.90], 0.12),
        'fiber': ([0.83, 0.81, 0.72, 1], 0.10),
        'hose': ([0.23, 0.44, 0.48, 0.82], 0.35),
        'water': ([0.26, 0.65, 0.82, 0.12], 0.30),
        'sample': ([0.34, 0.72, 0.94, 0.48], 0.32),
        'white': ([0.86, 0.87, 0.82, 1], 0.20),
        'red': ([0.47, 0.13, 0.12, 1], 0.25)
    }
    for name, (rgba, spec) in materials.items():
        el(asset, 'material', name=name, rgba=rgba, specular=spec, shininess=0.35)
    for name in ['s220', 'ch03', 'warning', 'holder']:
        el(asset, 'texture', name=name+'_tex', type='2d', file='textures/'+name+'.png')
        el(asset, 'material', name=name+'_label', texture=name+'_tex', texrepeat=[1, 1],
           rgba=[1, 1, 1, 1], specular=0.15)

    world = el(root, 'worldbody')

    parts, interfaces, connections, events, buttons = [], [], [], [], []
    mesh_counter = 0
    wedge_cache = {}

    def mesh(vertices, faces, prefix='mesh', uv=None):
        nonlocal mesh_counter
        mesh_counter += 1
        name = prefix+'_'+str(mesh_counter)
        args = dict(name=name, vertex=np.asarray(vertices).reshape(-1), face=np.asarray(faces, int).reshape(-1))
        if uv is not None:
            args['texcoord'] = np.asarray(uv).reshape(-1)
        el(asset, 'mesh', **args)
        return name

    def prism(poly, halfheight, prefix='prism'):
        n = len(poly)
        vs = [[x, y, -halfheight] for x, y in poly] + [[x, y, halfheight] for x, y in poly]
        fs = []
        for i in range(1, n-1):
            fs.extend([[0, i+1, i], [n, n+i, n+i+1]])
        for i in range(n):
            j = (i+1) % n
            fs.extend([[i, j, n+j], [i, n+j, n+i]])
        return mesh(vs, fs, prefix)

    def geom(body, name, kind='box', material='silver', pos=None, size=None, quat=None, **kw):
        return el(body, 'geom', name=name, type=kind, material=material, pos=pos, size=size, quat=quat, **kw)

    def box(body, name, pos, size, material='silver', **kw):
        return geom(body, name, pos=pos, size=size, material=material, **kw)

    def cylinder(body, name, pos, radius, halfheight, material='silver', **kw):
        return geom(body, name, kind='cylinder', pos=pos, size=[radius, halfheight], material=material, **kw)

    def segment(body, name, a, b, radius, material='steel'):
        return geom(body, name, kind='capsule', size=[radius], material=material, fromto=list(a)+list(b))

    def ring(body, name, center, ri, ro, height, material='silver', quat=None, count=40, visual=False):
        key = (round(ri, 10), round(ro, 10), round(height, 10), count)
        if key not in wedge_cache:
            h = math.pi/count
            poly = [(ri*math.cos(-h), ri*math.sin(-h)),
                    (ro*math.cos(-h), ro*math.sin(-h)),
                    (ro*math.cos(h), ro*math.sin(h)),
                    (ri*math.cos(h), ri*math.sin(h))]
            wedge_cache[key] = prism(poly, height/2, 'annulus_segment')
        q = np.array([1., 0., 0., 0.]) if quat is None else np.asarray(quat)
        for i in range(count):
            extra = dict(contype=0, conaffinity=0, group=1) if visual else {}
            geom(body, name+'_'+str(i), kind='mesh', pos=center,
                 quat=mul(q, axis_quat([0, 0, 1], 2*math.pi*i/count)),
                 material=material, mesh=wedge_cache[key], **extra)

    def rectangular_hole_plate(body, name, center, bounds, hole_r, thickness, material):
        xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax = bounds
        angles = list(np.linspace(-math.pi, math.pi, 65)[:-1])
        angles += [math.atan2(y, x) for x in [xmin, xmax] for y in [ymin, ymax]]
        angles = sorted(set(round(x, 12) for x in angles))
        for i, a in enumerate(angles):
            b = angles[(i+1) % len(angles)]
            if b <= a:
                b += 2*math.pi
            def boundary(t):
                x, y = math.cos(t), math.sin(t)
                tx = (xmax if x > 0 else xmin)/x if abs(x) > 1e-10 else 1e12
                ty = (ymax if y > 0 else ymin)/y if abs(y) > 1e-10 else 1e12
                return [min(tx, ty)*x, min(tx, ty)*y]
            p = [[hole_r*math.cos(a), hole_r*math.sin(a)], boundary(a), boundary(b),
                 [hole_r*math.cos(b), hole_r*math.sin(b)]]
            m = prism(p, thickness/2, 'aperture_plate')
            geom(body, name+'_'+str(i), kind='mesh', pos=center, material=material, mesh=m)

    def plaque(body, name, pos, width, height, material, quat=None):
        w, h, t = width/2, height/2, 0.00015
        vs = [[-w,-h,-t],[w,-h,-t],[w,h,-t],[-w,h,-t],
              [-w,-h,t],[w,-h,t],[w,h,t],[-w,h,t]]
        fs = [[0,2,1],[0,3,2],[4,5,6],[4,6,7],
              [0,1,5],[0,5,4],[1,2,6],[1,6,5],
              [2,3,7],[2,7,6],[3,0,4],[3,4,7]]
        uv = [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]*2
        geom(body, name, kind='mesh', material=material, pos=pos, quat=quat,
             mesh=mesh(vs, fs, 'label_plate', uv))

    def site(body, name, pos, quat=None):
        el(body, 'site', name=name, pos=pos, quat=quat, type='sphere', size=0.0006,
           rgba=[0.1, 0.7, 0.3, 0], group=4)
        return name

    def part(pid, body):
        parts.append({'id': pid, 'body': body})

    def interface(iid, kind, body, sitename=None, axis=None, operation=None):
        item = {'id': iid, 'asset_id': 'A16', 'kind': kind, 'body': body}
        if sitename is not None:
            item['site'] = sitename
        if axis is not None:
            item['approach_axis'] = axis
        if operation is not None:
            item['operation'] = operation
        interfaces.append(item)
        return iid

    def inertia(body, mass, pos, diag):
        el(body, 'inertial', mass=mass, pos=pos, diaginertia=diag)

    def detachable(cid, b1, b2, iface, sites):
        eq = cid+'_weld'
        el(equality, 'weld', name=eq, body1=b1, body2=b2, solref=[0.004, 1])
        release, attach = cid+'.release', cid+'.attach'
        events.extend([{'id': release, 'interface': iface, 'action': 'release'},
                       {'id': attach, 'interface': iface, 'action': 'attach'}])
        connections.append({'id': cid, 'kind': 'detachable', 'equality': eq,
                            'release_event': release, 'attach_event': attach,
                            'irreversible': False, 'capture_sites': sites,
                            'position_tolerance_m': 0.001, 'angle_tolerance_rad': 0.08})

    main = el(world, 'body', name='A16_s220')

    part('A16.main_unit', 'A16_s220')
    for x in [-0.077, 0.077]:
        for y in [-0.235, 0.235]:
            cylinder(main, 's220_foot_'+str(x)+'_'+str(y), [x,y,0.004], 0.011, 0.004, 'black')
    box(main, 's220_base', [0,0,0.016], [0.100,0.265,0.008], 'dark')
    box(main, 'bath_plinth', [0,-0.110,0.0295], [0.086,0.132,0.0055], 'silver')

    for x in [-0.096,0.096]:
        for y,z in [(0.07,0.20),(0.235,0.29),(0.235,0.06)]:
            cylinder(main,'housing_screw_'+str(x)+'_'+str(y)+'_'+str(z),
                     [x,y,z],0.002,0.0008,'steel',quat=z_to([1,0,0]))

    box(main,'bath_bottom',[0,-0.110,0.039],[0.085,0.125,0.004],'tank_glass')

            segment(main,'bath_corner_'+str(x)+'_'+str(y),[x,y,0.043],[x,y,0.165],0.0025,'steel')
    # Water is a visual continuum, not a collision solid filling the bath.
    box(main,'bath_water',[0,-0.110,0.098],[0.0805,0.1205,0.055],
        'water',contype=0,conaffinity=0,group=1)
    cylinder(main,'transducer_mount',[0,-0.115,0.045],0.025,0.002,'steel')

    for turn,z in enumerate([0.087,0.099,0.111]):

            segment(main,'cooling_coil_'+str(turn)+'_'+str(i),
                    [0.048*math.cos(a),-0.115+0.048*math.sin(a),z],
                    [0.048*math.cos(b),-0.115+0.048*math.sin(b),z],0.0018,'steel')
    for x in [-0.048,0.048]:
        segment(main,'coil_support_'+str(x),[x,-0.115,0.043],[x,-0.115,0.112],0.002,'steel')
    plaque(main,'bath_warning',[0,-0.2354,0.052],0.148,0.020,'warning_label',axis_quat([1,0,0],math.pi/2))
    for k in range(13):

    # A visible, permanently hinged safety assembly; no detachable-lid substitution.

    for x in [-0.087,0.087]:

        cylinder(main,'safety_hinge_knuckle_'+str(x),[x,0.016,0.172],0.005,0.006,'steel',quat=z_to([1,0,0]))
    lid=el(main,'body',name='A16_safety_lid',pos=hinge_origin)
    inertia(lid,0.480,[0,-0.126,0.015],[0.0031,0.0013,0.0039])

    lid_iface=interface('A16.safety_cover','grasp','A16_safety_lid','safety_cover_grasp',[0,-1,0],

    el(equality,'joint',name='safety_cover_latch',joint1='safety_lid_hinge',polycoef=[0,0,0,0,0],solref=[0.004,1])

    # The 500114 is a single-tube clamp with cylindrical head and a wire cage.

    cylinder(holder,'holder_lower_barrel',hp([0,-0.115,0.182]),0.012,0.017,'light_silver')
    ring(holder,'holder_cap_socket',hp([0,-0.115,0.16075]),0.0056,0.0068,0.0085,'steel',count=40)

    site(holder,'holder_grasp',hp([0,-0.115,0.238]))
    interface('A16.holder.grasp','grasp','A16_holder_500114','holder_grasp',[0,0,1])

    tube=el(world,'body',name='A16_tube_520045',pos=[0,-0.115,0.141])
    el(tube,'freejoint',name='tube_free')
    inertia(tube,0.001992,[0,0,0.010],[8e-8,8e-8,1.5e-8])
    part('A16.tube_520045','A16_tube_520045')
    # Exactly 6 mm OD and 16 mm end-to-end glass length, excluding the cap.
    ring(tube,'glass_tube_wall',[0,0,0.0083],0.0025,0.003,0.0154,'tube_glass',count=64)
    cylinder(tube,'glass_tube_bottom',[0,0,0.0003],0.003,0.0003,'tube_glass')
    ring(tube,'snap_cap_skirt',[0,0,0.018],0.00315,0.0054,0.005,'cap_clear',count=48)
    ring(tube,'snap_cap_top',[0,0,0.02075],0.0023,0.0054,0.0005,'cap_clear',count=48)
    # Retained internal fiber bears on the closed glass bottom.
    cylinder(tube,'acoustic_fiber',[0,0,0.0078],0.00035,0.0072,'fiber')
    liquid_outer=0.00248
    liquid_inner=0.00035
    liquid_h=50e-9/(math.pi*(liquid_outer**2-liquid_inner**2))
    ring(tube,'sample_50ul',[0,0,0.0006+liquid_h/2],liquid_inner,liquid_outer,liquid_h,

    site(tube,'tube_grasp',[0,0.0054,0.018])
    interface('A16.tube.grasp','grasp','A16_tube_520045','tube_grasp',[0,1,0])
    site(tube,'tube_cap_capture',[0,0,0.0155])
    site(holder,'tube_socket_capture',hp([0,-0.115,0.1565]))
    interface('A16.tube.load','insert','A16_tube_520045','tube_cap_capture',[0,0,-1])

    site(tube,'diaphragm_pipette_port',[0,0,0.02105])
